gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o2 -> i2: A unit test to test the basic functions of {@link BoundedIterator}. @param <E> the type of elements tested by this iterator.
UPDATED o3 -> i3: Test array of size 7
ADDED i4: The {@link #testArray} exposed as a {@code List<E>}; rebuilt before each test.
ADDED i5: Asserts that the iterator reports another element and that {@link Iterator#next()} returns the {@code expected} value. @param iter the iterator to advance @para
ADDED i6: Asserts that the iterator is exhausted: {@link Iterator#hasNext()} is {@code false} and {@link Iterator#next()} throws {@link NoSuchElementException}. @param it
ADDED i10: A max of 0 means no elements are in range, regardless of offset.
ADDED i12: max=10 exceeds the 6 remaining elements, so iteration stops at the decorated iterator's end: indexes 1..6 -> "b".."g".
ADDED i16: offset=10 skips past every element, leaving nothing to return.
ADDED i18: A second remove() with no intervening next() is illegal.
ADDED i20: Removing the first in-range element does not affect the rest: "c".."f".
ADDED i22: next() past the end throws an unmessaged NoSuchElementException.
ADDED i23: remove() after the last next() still removes that last element ("f").
ADDED i25: Iteration continues unaffected after a mid-stream remove: "e","f".
ADDED i27: A decorated iterator whose remove() is unsupported.
ADDED i28: BoundedIterator should propagate the decorated iterator's failure.
ADDED i30: remove() before any next() is illegal, even with a non-zero offset.
ADDED i32: Window [offset=0, max=size) covers everything: "a".."g".
